name: Defensive Asset Allocation (Canary Breadth)
description: Keller & Keuning (2018) DAA. Monthly. Monitors canary assets (EM equity + bonds) for weakness. Shifts allocation to SAFE (bonds) when many canary assets are in downtrend. Otherwise allocates to top-momentum risky assets (equities + gold). Uses 13612W momentum weighting (1m,3m,6m,12m with 12,4,2,1 weights).
